_sources.Benchmarkit_2024_PDF: Benchmarkit 2024 B2B SaaS Performance Metrics Benchmark Report — N=936 private B2B SaaS companies, CY-2023 actuals. Used for cohort-level distribution shapes and confirmed anchors: (1) arr_growth overall Q3=60%; (2) $50-100M arr_growth median=12%; (3) $1-5M arr_growth median=32%; (4) GRR overall Q1=79% in 2023; (5) NRR overall private SaaS median=101%; (6) subscription-only gross_margin median=79%; (7) S&M as % revenue: Q1=21%, median=34%, Q3=47%.
_sources.OpenView_HighAlpha_2024: High Alpha / OpenView 2024 SaaS Benchmarks Report — N≈800+ private SaaS companies. ARR growth by band: <$1M=100%, $1-5M=50%, $5-20M=30%, $20-50M=30% (rebounded), >$50M=15%. NRR steady at 110% (venture-backed sample). Used for ARR growth distribution shapes.
_sources.KeyBanc_Sapphire_2024: KeyBanc Capital Markets & Sapphire Ventures 15th Annual Private SaaS Survey (Oct 2024) — N=104+ private companies, median $26M ARR. PRIMARY SOURCE for CY2024E medians and top-quartile values. Confirmed CY2024E overall medians: ARR Growth 19%, NRR 101%, GRR 91%, Magic Number 0.7, CAC Payback 20mo, Gross Margin 72%, EBITDA -6%, Rule of 40 15%. Confirmed CY2024E top-quartile (P75): ARR Growth 27%, NRR 109%, GRR 95%, Magic Number 1.0, CAC Payback 14mo (lower=better so P75=best quartile), Gross Margin 81%, EBITDA +6%, Rule of 40 31%.
_sources.SaaS_Capital_2025: SaaS Capital 2025 Private Company Growth Rate Benchmarks — N=1,000+ private SaaS. Overall median growth 25% (equity-backed: 25%, bootstrapped: 23%). Rule of 40 declined 2023-2025 across most bands. Used for corroboration of growth rate compression trends.
_sources.Optifai_2024: Optifai NRR study — N=939 B2B SaaS companies segmented by ACV tier. Enterprise ($100K+ ACV)=118%, mid-market ($25K-100K)=108%, SMB (<$25K)=97%. By vertical: vertical SaaS=118%, horizontal/sales-mktg=110%, HR/collab=105%, SMB-focused=95%. Used for cohort-level NRR distribution shapes.
_sources.ChartMogul_2024: ChartMogul SaaS Retention Report 2024 — N=2,100+ venture-backed SaaS. Venture-backed NRR median=106%. Median company with NRR≥100% grew 48% YoY.
_sources.BVP_Bessemer: Bessemer Venture Partners SaaS benchmarks. CAC payback targets: SMB <12 mo, mid-market <18 mo, enterprise <24 mo.
_sources.Scale_VP: Scale Venture Partners benchmarking. Burn multiple pooled average ~1.4x at $25-50M ARR.
_sources.methodology_note: PRIMARY VINTAGE: CY2024E from KeyBanc/Sapphire 15th Annual Private SaaS Survey (Oct 2024). The growth|vertical_saas|25-50M cohort has directly confirmed medians and P75 values. All other cohorts are adjusted proportionally from the 2023→2024E shifts observed: ARR growth compressed ~30%, EBITDA improved ~+10-12 pts, NRR declined ~8-9 pts, GRR improved ~+2 pts. Q1/Q3 STATUS: (a) CONFIRMED where the PDF explicitly states the value; (b) ESTIMATED from IQR range signals; (c) DERIVED proportionally from the 2023→2024E shift applied to prior cohort Q1/Q3 values.

_valuation_multiples._note: ARR revenue multiples for private SaaS transactions and funding rounds. Source: Carta/PitchBook 2024 secondary data, BVP State of the Cloud 2024. Adjusted down ~30% from 2021 peak. Reflect 2024 market, not 2021.

early|vertical_saas|5-10M._notes: CY2024E. arr_growth median=28%: early vertical SaaS still above market median; proportionally adjusted from 2023 (38%) using ~26% compression consistent with KeyBanc 2024E overall market decline; early stage retains higher growth premium. Q1/Q3 derived from shape (right-skewed). nrr median=96%: early stage is predominantly SMB ACV (<$25K); Optifai SMB=97%; 2024E decline of ~8pts from 2023 value of 103% → ~95-96%. ebitda median=-24%: proportional improvement from -36% (2023) by +12pts per KeyBanc 2024E market trend; early companies still deeply unprofitable. rule_of_40 median=18: from 2023 value of 26 minus 8pt decline; wide Q3 driven by high-growth outliers. gross_margin=68% (blended incl. services; early vertical has more implementation drag). burn_multiple median=1.6: early companies improving capital efficiency in 2024; down from 1.8 (2023). All Q1/Q3 estimated or derived from shape.

growth|vertical_saas|10-25M._notes: CY2024E. arr_growth median=23%: proportionally adjusted from 2023 (32%) using ~28% compression; mid-growth vertical SaaS. nrr median=100%: proportional decline of 8pts from 2023 value of 108%; consistent with KeyBanc 2024E overall NRR of 101% at median $26M ARR. grr median=90%: improved 2pts from 2023 value of 88% per market trend. ebitda median=-13%: improved 12pts from 2023 value of -25%; companies in $10-25M band continue investing aggressively but with improving efficiency. rule_of_40 median=18: from 26 minus 8pt decline. gross_margin=70-71% (blended; subscription-only ~77-78%). All Q1/Q3 estimated proportionally from 2023 values.

growth|vertical_saas|25-50M._notes: PRIMARY DEMO COHORT. CY2024E figures from KeyBanc/Sapphire 15th Annual Private SaaS Survey (Oct 2024), N=104+ companies, median $26M ARR. CONFIRMED medians (PDF): arr_growth=19%, nrr=101%, grr=91%, magic_number=0.7, cac_payback=20mo, gross_margin=72%, ebitda=-6%, rule_of_40=15. CONFIRMED top-quartile/P75 (PDF): arr_growth Q3=27%, nrr Q3=109%, grr Q3=95%, magic_number Q3=1.0, cac_payback Q1=14mo (lower=better so P75 performance = Q1), gross_margin Q3=81%, ebitda Q3=+6%, rule_of_40 Q3=31. P25 values (Q1/Q3 for lower_better) are estimated from distribution shapes. burn_multiple and ltv_cac are derived from Scale VP/BVP targets; no 2024E primary survey data available.

late|vertical_saas|50-100M._notes: CY2024E. arr_growth median=10%: Benchmarkit confirmed $50-100M median=12% in CY2023; proportional 2024E compression → ~10%. nrr median=106%: late stage enterprise ACV; proportional decline of 7pts from 2023 value of 113%; large enterprise contracts more resilient. grr median=94%: improved 2pts from 2023 value of 92%. ebitda median=+4%: late stage companies approaching or at profitability in 2024E; improved 12pts from 2023 value of -8%. Q1 likely still slightly negative, Q3 at +17% for best performers. rule_of_40 median=14: from 20 minus 8pt decline; lower growth offset by EBITDA improvement. magic_number=0.60: late stage sales efficiency naturally lower, proportional adjustment from 0.70 (2023). burn_multiple=0.7: late stage improving efficiency. All Q1/Q3 estimated proportionally.

growth|horizontal_saas|10-25M._notes: CY2024E. Horizontal SaaS has less domain lock-in and higher competitive pressure vs vertical. arr_growth median=18%: proportional from 2023 (26%) with ~31% compression plus horizontal discount. nrr median=96%: OpenView confirmed horizontal underperformed vertical in 2024; proportional decline of 9pts from 103% (applying similar magnitude to 2023 value of 105%, adjusting for horizontal starting lower). grr median=88%: improved ~2pts from 2023. ebitda median=-14%: improved 12pts from -26% (2023). rule_of_40 median=14: from 22 minus 8pts. gross_margin=72% (blended; horizontal has less services drag vs vertical at this stage). All Q1/Q3 estimated proportionally.

growth|horizontal_saas|25-50M._notes: CY2024E. Horizontal SaaS $25-50M: higher competitive displacement than vertical, lower NRR. arr_growth median=16%: proportional from 2023 (24%) with ~33% compression; horizontal underperformed per OpenView 2024. nrr median=98%: declined 9pts from 2023 value of 107%; horizontal horizontal mid-market retention under pressure in 2024. grr=88%: improved ~2pts from 86% (2023). ebitda median=-8%: improved 12pts from -20% (2023); horizontal SaaS improving unit economics. rule_of_40 median=12: from 20 minus 8pts; lower than vertical equivalent. magic_number median=0.65: horizontal requires more S&M for same ARR. All Q1/Q3 estimated proportionally.

growth|fintech|25-50M._notes: CY2024E. Fintech SaaS growth rates held up somewhat better than horizontal SaaS due to financial services digitization tailwinds. arr_growth median=24%: proportional from 2023 (32%) with ~25% compression (less than market average). nrr median=103%: declined 9pts from 2023 (112%); transaction-volume-linked expansion partially offset by macro pressure on fintech customers. grr=90%: improved 2pts; fintech contracts sticky due to compliance/switching costs. ebitda median=-10%: improved 12pts from -22% (2023). gross_margin=65%: fintech blended ~60-70% due to payment processing / interchange costs; unchanged from 2023. rule_of_40 median=16: from 22 minus 6pts (smaller decline due to better growth retention). All Q1/Q3 estimated proportionally.

_widened|vertical_saas._notes: CY2024E. Stage-agnostic vertical SaaS fallback. Weighted average of early ($5-10M), growth ($10-25M, $25-50M), and late ($50-100M) cohorts, 2024E figures. All Q1/Q3 derived from shape. Use with confidence=medium.

_widened|horizontal_saas._notes: CY2024E. Stage-agnostic horizontal SaaS fallback. OpenView 2024 confirmed horizontal underperformed vertical across all ARR bands. All Q1/Q3 derived from shape. Use with confidence=medium.

_widened|default._notes: CY2024E. Cross-cohort default fallback. Anchored to KeyBanc/Sapphire 2024E confirmed overall medians where available. All Q1/Q3 except cac_payback Q1 (confirmed=14mo) are derived from shape. Use with confidence=low.
